items.title: Matte Matcha Bar at Makers Mart holiday craft fair
items.description: Sacramento's holiday craft fair with 70+ artisans, a DJ and a raffle. Matte Matcha Bar, the mobile matcha cafe, serves specialty matcha drinks alongside Mellobun's pastries. Admission is a $5 suggested donation and parking is free.
items.notes: happeningnext page names Matte Matcha Bar and Mellobun as vendors with date, 11-5 and street address. Single third-party listing (organizer has not claimed it); two other listings confirm date and address but do not list vendors, so recheck sacmakersmart.com/events.

items.title: Latte Syndrome matcha and Vietnamese coffee pop-up at Me Va Con
items.venue: Me Va Con Vietnamese Kitchen (sidewalk pop-up)
items.description: A Vietnamese-owned matcha and coffee pop-up that sets up in front of Me Va Con on Telegraph Avenue. Reviewers recommend the banana matcha and the strawberry einspanner, about $8 each.
items.notes: Weekly schedule from Instagram profile snippet: sets up in front of Me Va Con on Thursdays 10am-4pm. Address of Me Va Con from East Bay Express and listings, not from the brand. Reviewer says to check the page for where they pop up next; Nov 26 (Thanksgiving), Dec 24 and Dec 31 left out as unlikely. An earlier sweep's 'Dec 10, Porter Ranch' snippet is an unrelated LA post.

items.title: For the Love of Matcha at Grand Lake Farmers Market
items.description: A weekly matcha pop-up at the Grand Lake Farmers Market in Oakland that closes once it sells out, so go early. Seasonal specials such as sweet potato matcha rotate in.
items.notes: Weekly schedule from KQED (weekly pop-up at Grand Lake and Temescal markets, sells out), a Joe Coffee listing (Sat 9-2, Sun 9-1, Splash Pad Park 746 Grand Ave), and the brand's Nov 14 reel (Temescal market 9am-1pm). Neither market's vendor directory names the brand online; Grand Lake closes Dec 26. Earlier sweep had the Temescal dates as unsure.
